items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And then a guy who’s been with us recording and on tour, Steve Bagley the drummer.

ctx.x: And then a guy who’s been with us recording and on tour, Steve Bagley the drummer. And so it was alumni. We rehearsed them and did the concert and it turned out to be wonderful, it was just perfect.
It was in a beautiful little theater, just the right size.
